description: Arabic-letter variable names (D-1 Saudi curriculum convention, D-10 renderer safety net). Mathematics and Physics only; the conjunction و is never a variable.

entries.source: Draft transcription of the Arabic letter names used for variables in Saudi school mathematics (D-1, D-10: س، ص، ع …); pending curriculum reviewer transcription from the textbooks
entries.notes: Bare alef; textbooks usually write أ
